Title: [Orbit Notification] New Opportunity Created
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
The source requirement states that a notification should be sent when a new Opportunity is created, but it also notes that not all new Opportunities should trigger an email and asks whether the trigger can be button-based.

Recommended approach:
- Do not build this as a blanket automatic email.
- Build a user-controlled send action from the Opportunity record.
- Optionally restrict use to open Opportunities only.
- Optionally prevent resend unless an approved override exists.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Manual Quick Action or button-launched Screen Flow on Opportunity record
- **Trigger/Event:** Manual user-initiated send from Opportunity record after the Opportunity has been created and saved
- **Send timing:** Immediate on button click
- **Recipients:** rfp.rfi@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `New Opportunity Submitted for Proposal Support. {!Opportunity.Name}`

## Required email content fields
- Opportunity Name
- Account
- Amount
- Stage
- Close Date
- Owner
- Opportunity Type
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a saved qualifying Opportunity, when the user clicks the send action, then one email is sent to the configured recipient.
- Given the same Opportunity, when the user attempts a second send, then the system either blocks or logs the resend based on the agreed resend rule.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm whether resend is allowed and who can use it.
- Confirm whether the action should include a review/confirm screen before send.
- Add sent date/time and sending user to the Opportunity or notification log.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Critical Stage Progression Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Send an immediate email when an Opportunity progresses into a critical probability band.

Entry criteria:
- Opportunity is updated.
- Probability changes from any previous value to 75% or 90%.
- Do not send if the value remains unchanged.
- Do not send on creation unless the business explicitly confirms that initial creation counts as progression.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Record-Triggered Flow on Opportunity update
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic when Opportunity Probability changes into 75% or 90%
- **Send timing:** Immediate
- **Recipients:** rfp.rfi@astrumcro.com, jordi.picas@astrumcro.com, cristina.lopes@astrumcro.com, anthony.gibson@astrumcro.com, vania.araujo@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Critical Stage Progression. {!Opportunity.Name} moved to {!Opportunity.Probability}`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Previous Probability
- New Probability
- Stage
- Service Fees
- Close Date
- Study Countries
- Therapeutic Area
- Indication
- Entities Providing Services
- Next Specific Action
- Date of Next Specific Action
- Person Responsible for Next Specific Action
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an Opportunity with Probability 50%, when Probability changes to 75%, then one email is sent immediately.
- Given an Opportunity already at 75%, when it is saved without a Probability change, then no email is sent.
- Given an Opportunity moving from 75% to 90%, then a new email is sent immediately.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm API names for the subject-matter fields included in the email.
- Confirm whether initial creation at 75% or 90% should trigger the alert.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Stalled Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Surface open Opportunities that appear stalled so leadership can intervene.

Recommended qualifying logic:
- Opportunity is open and not Closed Won / Closed Lost.
- Either Stage or Probability has not changed for at least 30 days, OR
- There is no recent activity based on the agreed activity proxy.

Recommended design decision:
- Use Date of Next Specific Action as the activity proxy if standard activity data is not reliable.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Scheduled Flow with bi-weekly digest email
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic scheduled evaluation of open Opportunities with no movement or no recent activity proxy
- **Send timing:** Bi-weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com, catherine.canales@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Bi-Weekly Stalled Opportunities Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Service Fees
- Amount
- Stage
- Days in current Stage/Probability state
- Days since last activity or agreed activity proxy
- Close Date
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an open Opportunity with no stage/probability movement for 31 days, when the digest runs, then the Opportunity appears in the digest.
- Given an Opportunity updated before the next digest run, then it no longer appears in the digest.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Critical clarification required on the activity proxy: LastActivityDate, Date of Next Specific Action, or custom date.
- May require field history tracking or helper fields to track last Stage / Probability movement.
- Digest should avoid repeatedly surfacing unchanged items within the same cycle unless business wants repetition.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Close Date Risk Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Flag open Opportunities whose planned close date is within 90 days but whose readiness indicators suggest execution risk.

Recommended qualifying logic:
- Opportunity is open.
- Close Date is within the next 90 days from run date.
- At least one of the following is true:
  - Probability is 50% or less
  - Stage is before Verbal Award
  - Date of Next Specific Action is more than 7 days in the past
  - Service Fees = 0

The digest should show exactly which readiness rule(s) failed for each Opportunity.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Scheduled Flow with weekly digest email
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic scheduled evaluation of open Opportunities closing within 90 days with incomplete readiness indicators
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com, catherine.canales@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Weekly Close Date Risk Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Service Fees
- Close Date
- Next Specific Action
- Person Responsible for Next Specific Action
- Latest Activity Date
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an open Opportunity within 90 days of Close Date and Service Fees = 0, when the digest runs, then it appears with the failed rule identified.
- Given an Opportunity beyond the 90-day window, then it does not appear even if other risks exist.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm which Stage values are considered before Verbal Award.
- Confirm whether Latest Activity Date should use LastActivityDate or another source field.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Amount Change Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Detect material Opportunity amount changes and include them in a daily digest.

Qualifying logic:
- Prior Service Fees is not blank.
- If prior Service Fees < 250,000 and not zero, absolute delta >= 100,000.
- If prior Service Fees >= 250,000 and < 500,000, absolute delta >= 250,000.
- If prior Service Fees >= 500,000, absolute delta >= 350,000.

Use absolute delta for qualification but show the signed delta in the digest.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Record-Triggered Flow to capture qualifying Service Fees changes plus a daily digest sender
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic when Service Fees changes materially based on the prior amount bucket
- **Send timing:** Daily digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Daily Opportunity Amount Change Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Old Service Fees
- New Service Fees
- Delta
- Stage
- Close Date
- Owner
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given prior Service Fees of 200,000 and new Service Fees of 310,000, when the daily digest runs, then the Opportunity appears in the digest.
- Given prior Service Fees of 300,000 and new Service Fees of 510,000, then the Opportunity appears in the digest.
- Given prior Service Fees of 600,000 and new Service Fees of 850,000, then the Opportunity does not appear because the delta does not meet the configured threshold.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm Service Fees field API name and currency handling.
- Decide whether multiple same-day changes should be shown as separate rows or as one net change per day.
- Requires notification queue or log object for digest staging.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Close Date Change Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Highlight potentially risky close date slippage and frequent close date churn.

Recommended qualifying logic:
- New Close Date is pushed out by more than 60 days compared with old Close Date, OR
- Close Date has been pushed out 3 or more times within the last 90 days.

This requirement cannot be delivered robustly as a simple email alert because it depends on historical counts.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Record-Triggered Flow to log close date changes plus a weekly digest sender
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic when Close Date changes
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com, catherine.canales@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Weekly Close Date Change Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Previous Close Date
- New Close Date
- Number of date changes in rolling 90 days
- Stage
- Service Fees
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an Opportunity whose Close Date slips by 70 days, when the weekly digest runs, then it appears in the digest.
- Given an Opportunity with a third push-out inside 90 days, then it appears even if the latest slip is less than 60 days.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm whether only push-outs count or all Close Date changes count.
- Confirm whether pulling the Close Date in should also alert.
- Requires persistent change logging beyond a simple email alert.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Probability / Forecast Category Change Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Track meaningful forecast movement and surface it in a weekly digest.

Recommended default logic until business confirms the final rule:
- Any downward Probability movement, OR
- Any backward Forecast Category movement, OR
- Any Probability / Forecast Category change during the last 30 days of the fiscal quarter.

The digest should show whether the change was Probability, Forecast Category, or both.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Record-Triggered Flow to log qualifying Probability / Forecast Category changes plus a weekly digest sender
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic when Probability or Forecast Category changes materially
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com, catherine.canales@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Weekly Forecast Movement Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Old Forecast Value or Category
- New Forecast Value or Category
- Service Fees
- Close Date
- Stage
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Probability drops from 75% to 50%, when the weekly digest runs, then the Opportunity appears in the digest.
- Given Forecast Category moves from Commit to Best Case, then the Opportunity appears in the digest.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Business must define what counts as a material change.
- Confirm exact Forecast Category values in use.
- Confirm whether upward late-quarter changes should also alert.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Missing Key Data Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Run a weekly data-quality check and notify owners plus leadership where key data is missing or inconsistent.

Checks listed in scope include:
- Service Fees = 0
- Probability blank
- Award Date blank when Stage is Verbal Award or Contract Agreed, or Probability is 75% or 90%
- Next Specific Action blank
- Date of Next Specific Action blank
- Person Responsible for Next Action blank
- Is Funding Available blank
- Indication blank
- Number of Enrolled Participants blank
- Study Countries blank
- Number of Sites blank
- Protocol Title blank
- If Stage = Closed Won, Close Date must equal Contract Signed Date
- If Stage has been or is Closed Won / Closed Lost, fields must not change after closure
- RFP Received Date must be in the same calendar year as Opportunity Created Date
- If Stage = Closed Won or Closed Lost, Close Date must not be in a future year

Strong recommendation:
- Treat post-close field lock requirements as validation / record lock controls, not just notifications.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Scheduled Flow with weekly digest email, supported by validation rules or record controls where prevention is stronger than notification
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic scheduled evaluation of open and closed Opportunities against missing-data and data-integrity checks
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** Opportunity Owner, tom.frearson@astrumcro.com
- **Suggested email subject:** `Weekly Opportunity Data Quality Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Description of missing fields or failed checks
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an open Opportunity missing Next Specific Action, when the weekly digest runs, then the Opportunity appears with the missing field listed.
- Given a Closed Won Opportunity where Close Date does not match Contract Signed Date, then the issue is surfaced in the digest or blocked by a stronger preventative control.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Final field list and API mapping required.
- Confirm Stage values for Verbal Award and Contract Agreed.
- Decide which checks must be blocked via validation rather than only notified.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Opportunity Closed Won Notification
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Send an immediate Closed Won email when an Opportunity first becomes Closed Won.

Key rules:
- Fire only once when Stage first changes to Closed Won.
- Determine recipients using the agreed Business Category + Service Fees matrix.
- Include the mandatory fixed line:
  'If not already performed, a handover call will be scheduled with the relevant stakeholders following this email.'

Note:
- Current source logic only explicitly covers Business Category values Phase I Unit and Phase I-NIS.
- Any other Business Category needs a confirmed routing rule before build.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Record-Triggered Flow on Stage change to Closed Won
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic when Opportunity Stage changes to Closed Won
- **Send timing:** Immediate
- **Recipients:** Dynamic recipient matrix by Business Category and Service Fees threshold, plus Opportunity Owner
- **Suggested email subject:** `Closed Won. {!Opportunity.Name}`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Business Category
- Service Fees
- Total Fees
- Project Start Work
- Project End Work
- Study Countries
- Phase
- Therapeutic Area
- Indication
- Number of Enrolled Participants
- Number of Sites
- Entities Providing Services
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a qualifying Phase I Unit Opportunity under the configured threshold, when Stage changes to Closed Won, then the email is sent to the correct recipient matrix.
- Given a qualifying Phase I-NIS Opportunity above the configured threshold, when Stage changes to Closed Won, then the expanded matrix is used.
- Given an Opportunity already Closed Won, when it is edited without Stage changing from a non-won state, then no duplicate email is sent.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Confirm Business Category picklist values and thresholds.
- Confirm whether Service Fees and Total Fees are separate fields and both must be shown.
- Build and test recipient matrix logic before deployment.

## Delivery notes
- This issue was derived from the approved Orbit Opportunities Salesforce notification requirements specification.
- Confirm all Salesforce API names during build.
- Confirm whether a reusable notification log / queue object is needed for digest-based notifications.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Large Opportunity Aged in Stage Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Escalate large Opportunities that have remained at 50% Probability or below for more than 3 months.

Recommended qualifying logic:
- Business Category = Phase I Unit and Service Fees > 250,000 and Probability <= 50% for more than 3 months, OR
- Business Category = Phase I-NIS and Service Fees > 500,000 and Probability <= 50% for more than 3 months.

Important:
- If the real business intent is time in Stage rather than time at low Probability, that must be corrected before build.

## Recommended Salesforce design
- **Pattern:** Scheduled Flow with weekly digest email
- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic scheduled evaluation of high-value Opportunities aged at low Probability for more than 3 months
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com, catherine.canales@astrumcro.com, Opportunity Owner
- **Suggested email subject:** `Weekly Large Opportunity Aged-in-Stage Digest`

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Service Fees
- Stage
- Probability
- Close Date
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a Phase I Unit Opportunity with Service Fees 260,000 at 50% for 95 days, when the digest runs, then it appears in the digest.
- Given a Phase I-NIS Opportunity with Service Fees 450,000, then it does not appear even if aged.

## Dependencies / open questions
- Requires a robust way to track when the Opportunity entered the low-probability state.
- Confirm whether the rule is truly time at low Probability or time in Stage.

Title: [Orbit Notification] Project Code or Change Order Issue Alert
Description:
## Summary
Build the Salesforce notification requirement as a Linear-managed delivery item.

## Business requirement
Notify on Opportunity records with project code issues or Change Order classification.

Qualifying logic:
- Opportunity Code is blank, OR
- Opportunity Code does not match format AAA####, meaning exactly three letters followed by four digits, OR
- Business Type = Change Order

Recommended implementation note:
- If regex evaluation is difficult in Flow alone, use a helper formula or validation helper field.

## Recommended Salesforce design

- **Trigger/Event:** Automatic scheduled evaluation of Opportunity Code quality and Change Order conditions
- **Send timing:** Weekly digest
- **Recipients:** tom.frearson@astrumcro.com

## Required email content fields
- Account Name
- Opportunity Code
- Opportunity Name
- Service Fees
- Stage
- Probability
- Close Date
- Salesforce record link

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Opportunity Code AB1234, when the digest runs, then the Opportunity appears because the code format is invalid.
- Given Opportunity Code ABC1234, then it does not appear for code format alone.
- Given Business Type = Change Order, then the Opportunity appears regardless of code quality.
